strings.Eigener Zustand. Was er bewirkt, legt de: Custom condition. The DM decides what it does.

strings.Jeder Charakter hat sein eigenes Inventa: Every character has their own inventory with weapons, spells, coins and items. Players keep it up to date themselves; you can read along here and add things, e.g. loot they found. ⚙ next to “Coins” gives the coins custom names.

strings.Mit den Werkzeugen links auf der Karte z: Draw with the tools on the left of the map.

strings.Nach Initiativwert sortieren, der Höchst: Sort by initiative, highest goes first

strings.Szene um 90° gegen den Uhrzeigersinn dre: Rotate scene 90° anticlockwise (tokens, drawings and fog rotate too)

strings.Zum Beispiel ein Trank der Riesenstärke: For example a potion of giant strength or a curse. The score changes on the sheet immediately and returns to normal by itself when the rounds run out. Whether several effects stack is up to your table: the app adds them all together.
